item_name: Rothco Cut Resistant Lined Leather Gloves
item_short_desc: Rothco's Cut Resistant Lined Leather Gloves offer the perfect combination of protection and comfort. Made with high-quality cowhide aniline leather, these gloves are both soft and durable. The interior is lined with cut-resistant material, providing an extra layer of safety when handling sharp objects, ensuring your hands remain protected. Ideal for professionals in public safety, construction, or anyone needing added security in their day-to-day tasks, these gloves offer long-lasting durability without compromising on comfort.
